scope: Disjoint 30-image holdout for WSL2/Linux x86_64 + RTX 4060 Laptop native TensorRT mixed FP16/FP32 versus ORT CPU FP32

revision_rationale.v1_status: retained unchanged as a failed over-strict ORT TensorRT EP numerical-equivalence diagnostic
revision_rationale.v2_status: retained unchanged as a failed disjoint ORT TensorRT EP semantic gate
revision_rationale.v3_status: retained unchanged as the consumed first native holdout: CE2D25F9 class-Sigmoid FP16 failed one of 30 images at the immutable one-pixel coordinate gate while both native repetitions were identical
revision_rationale.tuning_rule: After v3 was consumed, the E0CBB0A8 DFL-Softmax-only FP16/noTF32 policy was selected with the score, NMS, and semantic gate unchanged; it passed all 90 v1+v2+v3 images before any v4 inference
revision_rationale.holdout_rule: v4 uses deterministic indices 244, 258, 273, 288, and 297, absent from v1, v2, and v3, and was frozen before any CPU or native inference on a v4 sample
revision_rationale.tolerance_basis: unchanged from v2 and v3: one source pixel coordinate bound, IoU 0.90, confidence 0.005, with exact count/class/name
revision_rationale.anti_tuning_rule: v4 samples, limits, provider contract, engine SHA, and precision policy are immutable after the first v4 run; a v4 failure must be reported and cannot be repaired by changing this protocol
revision_rationale.final_engine_freeze: The exact E0CBB0A8A620C1FCF3F8FE215BC716313A3884D2A9CCDE4F3D18B4571ABD8746 plan was built, its FP16 DFL Softmax layer was captured in layer information, and it passed a 100-iteration reload before this protocol was frozen and before any v4 inference

publication_limits: Publish native TensorRT performance only if this untouched v4 holdout passes; retain the failed ORT TensorRT EP v1/v2 and native v3 results beside it.
This proves local WSL2/Linux x86_64 GPU/edge-node execution, not Jetson, native ARM64 GPU, or embedded hardware.
This is implementation correctness on a bounded set, not full-dataset mAP or PyTorch lineage evidence.
